description.value: Zaatar w Zeit is a halal Lebanese restaurant on Granville Street in the heart of downtown Vancouver. Named after the iconic Middle Eastern herb-and-spice blend, it offers indoor dining in one of the city's busiest commercial corridors. For touring cyclists navigating downtown Vancouver, it represents a culturally distinct lunch or dinner option a short distance from the seawall and False Creek routes.
